definitions.explanation: A particular form or version of a published text.

examples.japanese: この{本|ほん}は{第|だい}3{版|はん}です。
examples.english: This book is the third edition.

examples.japanese: {改訂|かいてい}{版|はん}が{出版|しゅっぱん}された。
アプリの{最新|さいしん}{版|はん}をダウンロードする。
examples.english: To download the latest version of the app.

examples.japanese: {版画|はんが}は{版|はん}を{使|つか}って{刷|す}る{芸術|げいじゅつ}だ。
examples.english: Printmaking is an art that uses printing plates.

examples.japanese: {木|き}の{版|はん}に{絵|え}を{彫|ほ}って{刷|す}る。
examples.english: To carve a picture into a wooden block and print it.

examples.japanese: この{浮世絵|うきよえ}は{当時|とうじ}の{版|はん}から{刷|す}られたものだ。
examples.english: This ukiyo-e was printed from an original woodblock.

notes:
Used as a suffix to indicate editions or versions of publications and software.

COMMON COMPOUNDS:
・{初|しょ}{版|はん} (first edition)
・{改訂|かいてい}{版|はん} (revised edition)
・{新|しん}{版|はん} (new edition)
・{文庫|ぶんこ}{版|はん} (paperback edition)
・{電子|でんし}{版|はん} (digital/electronic version)
・{日本語|にほんご}{版|はん} (Japanese version)
・{限定|げんてい}{版|はん} (limited edition)

PRINTING TERMS:
・{版画|はんが} (woodblock print)
・{出版|しゅっぱん} (publishing)
